entries.what: Winds a Mainspring by hand. Your power on day one.
use: Right-click the crank with a [[mainspring]] to put it in.
Hold right-click on the crank with an empty hand.
Left-click pops the spring out.

rows: charges any FE item at 200 FE/t

entries.what: Burns any furnace fuel for FE. The first real generator.
use: Right-click it with coal, charcoal or logs.
Machines touching it get power, or put a [[tesla_coil_1]] on top.

entries.what: Free FE by day under open sky.
A battery block. Gives FE out on its front; the front gauge shows the charge. Keeps its charge when mined.
use: Feed it from a generator or cable.
Put a [[tesla_coil_1]] on it to send its FE wirelessly.

entries.what: Wireless power. On a generator or battery it sends that block's FE; anywhere else it relays.
use: Place it on a generator, [[accumulator_1]] or panel.
Sneak-right-click it with a [[tesla_linker]].
Right-click machines (the face you click is where power goes in) or other coils.

entries.what: Links Tesla Coils to machines and to other coils.
use: Sneak-right-click a coil to select it.
Right-click a machine face or another coil to link.
Click a linked face again to unlink. Sneak-right-click air clears the selection.

entries.what: Charges FE items: cells, tools, drills, armor.
use: Place it touching a generator, or feed it FE.
Right-click it with the item.

entries.what: Presses 1 ingot into 1 plate: twice what the hammer gives.
use: Right-click it with ingots or feed it with a hopper or pipe.
Set its faces in the Sides tab.

entries.what: Makes the Robotica alloys from up to three inputs. Only this machine makes them.
use: Right-click it with ingots or dusts, or pipe them in.
Power it with FE or a cell in its battery slot.
Right-click it with the next Mk to upgrade in place.

entries.what: Splits one input into up to four results, some by chance. Recycles Depleted Fuel Pellets.
use: Put the input in, power it.
Take results from the output or pipe them out.

entries.what: Builds parts from up to six inputs. Some parts exist only here; others cost about a quarter less than by hand.
use: Put every input in its own slot.
Power it: big parts need a lot of FE.

entries.what: Radioisotope Generator: burns Thorium Fuel Pellets one at a time. Quiet, steady power.
use: Put [[thorium_fuel_pellet]] in.
It pushes power into touching blocks; a [[tesla_coil_1]] on it sends it on.
Take out the [[depleted_fuel_pellet]] waste.
